bex CLI vdev-f296747d9

Create a new job for a service

USAGE
  bex jobs create [serviceID] [flags]

FLAGS
  -h, --help                      Show help for this command
      --plan-id <PLAN_ID>         Set the plan ID for the job (Optional)
      --start-command <COMMAND>   Set the job start command
      --confirm                   Skip all confirmation prompts
  -o, --output <FORMAT>           Set output format to interactive, json, yaml, or text. Auto-switches to text on non-TTY (default: "interactive")

EXAMPLES
  # Create a job for a service
  bex jobs create srv-abc123 --start-command "bundle exec rake task"

  # Create a job with a specific plan
  # Plan IDs match the service plans listed by `bex services get`
  bex jobs create srv-abc123 --start-command "npm run worker" --plan-id plan-srv-006

bex CLI vdev-f296747d9

List services and datastores for the active workspace

USAGE
  bex services [subcommand] [flags]

SUBCOMMANDS
  create               Create a new service or clone an existing one
  delete               Delete a service
  instances            List instances for a service
  update               Update configuration for an existing service

FLAGS
  -e, --environment-ids <ENV_IDS>   Filter services by comma-separated environment IDs
  -h, --help                        Show help for this command
      --include-previews            Include preview environments
      --confirm                     Skip all confirmation prompts
  -o, --output <FORMAT>             Set output format to interactive, json, yaml, or text. Auto-switches to text on non-TTY (default: "interactive")

EXAMPLES
  # List all services
  bex services

  # Output as JSON
  bex services --output json

  # Filter by environment
  bex services -e env-abc123

  # Include preview environments
  bex services --include-previews

  # Combine filters
  bex services -e env-abc123,env-def456 --include-previews --output json

DETAILS
Lists all services and datastores for the active workspace. In interactive mode,
you can view logs, restart services, trigger deploys, SSH into instances, and
connect to Bex Postgres databases and Bex Key Value instances.

Use "bex services [subcommand] --help" for more information about a command.
